definitions: A soft mixture of lime with sand or cement and water for spreading on walls, ceilings, or other structures to form a smooth hard surface.
A medical dressing consisting of a strip of material with a sticky adhesive surface, applied to the skin to cover a wound or hold a dressing in place.
Plaster of Paris, a white powder that forms a quick-setting paste when mixed with water, used for making casts and moulds.
A cast made of plaster of Paris to protect a broken bone.
examples: The plaster on the ceiling began to crack.
She put a plaster on her cut finger.
The artist used plaster for the sculpture.
He had his leg in plaster for six weeks.
